item.text: I’ll inspect `test/orders.js` and then summarize its behavior and any concrete bugs.

`test/orders.js` exports four order helpers:

- `calcTotal(items)`: sums `price × qty`.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)`: applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)`: calculates an average.
- `formatOrder(order)`: formats line items and the discounted total as text.

Bugs:

- [Line 5](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-fiSnbh/test/orders.js:5): `i <= items.length` iterates one past the end. `items[items.length]` is `undefined`, so line 6 throws a `TypeError`. It should be `i < items.length`.
- [Line 20](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-fiSnbh/test/orders.js:20): `averageItemPrice` divides the order total by the number of item entries, producing an average line total—not average unit price. It should likely sum `price` values or divide total quantity, depending on the intended meaning.
- Empty `items` also produces `NaN` in `averageItemPrice`; this may need explicit handling.
